title: Self-healing X13b: the evidence index cuts a CI log, a diff and the lessons, and the seat reads it at isolation.i5.stage enforce
summary: X13 (selfheal-orchestrator-agent-profile) writes the evidence index of an incident with the classes incident, signal, digest and retrospective. The classes ci-log, diff and lesson of llm-isolation.md §18.3 have no cut: the index names them only in notes, so a flaky-test diagnosis cannot name the test. An evolve agent run launch also has no index grant (§8.5), so at isolation.i5.stage=enforce the seat cannot read .evolve/runs/selfheal-<id>/. Spec: llm-isolation.md §18.6 Limits.
fix: Add a ci-log cut (the failed lines of gh run view --log-failed for each ci: source, taken by the pipeline, never by the seat), a diff cut for a landing source, and the lesson YAML files that name the subject or a source cycle. Give the agent-run launch of the seat a read grant for its evidence workspace, as the phase cells get for inputs/index.json.
acceptance: RED first: the index of the live ci-hang record has no ci-log entry today; after the change it lists one for each CI run
A flaky-test diagnosis cites a ci-log entry that names the test
At isolation.i5.stage=enforce the seat opens i1 of its evidence workspace and cannot open an unrelated run directory (sandbox contract row)
